mapper.select: select o.*,gi.image_url as goodsImage,g.`desc` as goods_desc, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, NOW(), DATE_ADD(o.creat_time, INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)) AS count_down from `order` as o JOIN goods as g ON g.id=o.goods_id JOIN goods_images gi ON gi.goods_id=o.goods_id where o.id=#{orderId} HAVING count_down>0 LIMIT 1

SELECT o.id, o.pay_money as res_pay, g.`desc` as goods_desc, MAX(CASE WHEN gi.image_order = (SELECT MIN(image_order) FROM goods_images AS gi2 WHERE gi2.goods_id = gi.goods_id) THEN gi.image_url END) as goods_image FROM `order` as o JOIN goods_images as gi ON gi.goods_id = o.goods_id JOIN goods as g on g.id = o.goods_id WHERE o.buyer = #{id} and (o.state=0 or o.state=1) GROUP BY o.id;
